title: BOLD: Dataset and Metrics for Measuring Biases in Open-Ended Language Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating open-ended language generation by triggering models with prompts containing male and female names, and scoring the outputs using sentiment analysis, toxicity classification, regard, psycholinguistic norms, and text gender polarity metrics.

Measuring sentiment, toxicity, regard, and psycholinguistic norms in texts generated by language models prompted with Wikipedia text containing names associated with different racial groups (European, African, Asian, and Hispanic/Latino Americans).
Analyzing texts generated from prompts associated with major religious and spiritual beliefs using automated metrics for sentiment, toxicity, and psycholinguistic affective meaning norms.
Assessing the sentiment, toxicity, and psycholinguistic norms of language model outputs triggered by prompts related to various political ideologies (e.g., socialism, liberalism, conservatism).
Measuring the gender polarity of language model generations triggered by prompts about various occupational categories to expose biased associations between specific professions and genders.
